title: Assistance Coordination Note: BadgerCare Plus Screening and Patient Payment Plan Pause Periods
content:
While BadgerCare Plus is screening a patient, the pause period for **Patient Payment Plan** installments during an open financial assistance application is longer. A financial assistance application of the patient is open when one of the patient's financial assistance cases in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) stands in submitted or pending documents status, a submitted case being taken first.

**Rule.** The pause period gains the open case's BadgerCare Plus screening deadline days when a BadgerCare Plus screening referral notice has been sent on the case and no BadgerCare Plus determination notice has been received as a document of the case; it gains the case's determination days when a referral notice has been sent and the determination notice has been received; and it gains nothing when no referral notice has been sent on the case or no application is open. The screening deadline days and the determination days are those the case's tier of the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) sets; the notices and documents are read from that case's record.

| Referral notice sent on the open case | Determination notice received as a case document | Days the pause period gains |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | the case's screening deadline days |
| Yes | Yes | the case's determination days |
| No | either | none |
| no open application | — | none |

**Hypothetical.** An open case whose tier sets 40 screening deadline days and 25 determination days: with a referral notice sent and no determination notice yet, the pause period gains 40 days; once the determination notice is logged as received, it gains 25 days instead.
